run_bruteforce_solve_tasks: run bruteforce search to solve PHYRE tasks using a specified action tier and max attempts
run_eval_single_task: run a single PHYRE task evaluation by sampling actions and simulating until solved or exhausted
run_get_task_dict: run task loading to retrieve a dictionary of tasks filtered by a given task prefix
run_save_canonical_solution: run bruteforce solving and save discovered solutions as canonical solution files for tasks
run_parallel_task_solving: run parallel bruteforce task solving across multiple workers using multiprocessing pool
